file_reasoning: Read-only searchable order list and detailed item overlay.

resource_binding_reasoning.reasoning: Immediate query text promises number/name/phone; no date or paging controls visible. Actual API cap/filter reviewed in VM independently; UI should disclose truncated history if backend bounded.
Nested rows pass real order to root command; header refresh icon unnamed. List type/total/status consistent server strings through converters, customer name wraps, fixed columns leave star narrow.
Detail scroll includes product/variant/notes/quantity/line total and customer address. Boundaries620wide max700height/margin24 require native smaller-screen check.

Footer gives total and method only, no IsPaid/pending confirmation status, no split amount legs, refund/cancellation or pending-payment reconciliation command in this view. Thus dashboard orders navigation alone does not expose full pending electronic action; primary cashier lookup separate.
Header close + scroll + pinned footer, no full receipt rendering or print action. This provides item inspection without physical printer but not faithful receipt preview.
Error/loading/no matching list overlays independent. No detail-specific loading/error region here; VM must delay open or surface detail read failure elsewhere.

tests_and_limits: NOT_EXECUTED. Native item viewing, stale detail responses, pending electronic visibility, bounded history search and screenreader refresh naming need tests. No callable declarations.
recommendations: Clearly show payment confirmation and split legs for financial follow-up; add separate receipt preview later only if authorized.
observation: SOURCE_ONLY; no native screenshot/runtime evidence; no source or application state changed
